name: Harappan-Lothal Industrial Union
notes: The guild nation. Foundries, clockwork factories and patent registries along the Saraswati estuaries, run from Kavik's retrofitted 22-story sandstone tower in Lothal. Descended from the Mask Family, Harappan stone-engineers and urbanised Kia artisans: a heavy-industrial federation of iron foundries, clockwork factories and copper solar-coil workshops, governed through trade ledgers, patent registries and civic councils. Kavik's ancient tower is its steam beacon and telegraph lighthouse. A nation of the Age of Machinery, on the pre-Shattering chart.
